name: Microsoft Xbox Series X|S family
summary: Explore the current Xbox generation — Series X (disc, 1–2 TB) and Series S (all-digital, 512 GB–1 TB). Same system software, same Developer Mode path, no public retail exploit documented.

specs.cpu: 8 cores at 3.8 GHz (3.6 GHz with SMT), custom Zen 2
specs.gpu: RDNA 2 — 12 TFLOPS / 52 CUs at 1.825 GHz (Series X); 4 TFLOPS / 20 CUs at 1.565 GHz (Series S)
specs.memory: 16 GB GDDR6, 320-bit bus (Series X); 10 GB GDDR6, 128-bit bus (Series S)
specs.storage: Custom NVMe SSD, 2.4 GB/s raw — 1 TB or 2 TB (Series X); 512 GB or 1 TB (Series S)
specs.media: 4K UHD Blu-ray (Series X disc model); digital-only editions exist on Series X; Series S is all-digital
specs.display: True 4K up to 120 fps, up to 8K HDR (Series X); 1440p up to 120 fps (Series S)

variants.storage: 1 TB or 2 TB custom NVMe SSD
variants.notes: Launch 2020-11-10. 12 TFLOPS GPU, 16 GB GDDR6, true 4K gaming. Disc drive on the Carbon Black model; digital-only editions also exist. Special editions change storage and finish, not the SoC.

specs.memory: 16 GB GDDR6, 320-bit (10 GB at 560 GB/s, 6 GB at 336 GB/s)

variants.storage: 512 GB or 1 TB custom NVMe SSD
variants.notes: Launch 2020-11-10. All-digital, 4 TFLOPS GPU, 10 GB GDDR6, targets 1440p. No disc drive.

specs.memory: 10 GB GDDR6, 128-bit (8 GB at 224 GB/s, 2 GB at 56 GB/s)

firmware.version: Microsoft system software, updated online; shared with Xbox One

homebrew.name: Developer Mode
homebrew.firmware: All firmware versions; entered through the Dev Mode app
homebrew.summary: Microsoft's sanctioned development environment for retail Xbox Series X|S consoles. It runs UWP apps including homebrew apps and emulators packaged for the console. Needs a Microsoft account and the Dev Mode activation; it does not give kernel-level control of the retail OS.

compatibility.note: Both models share the same system software and Developer Mode activation per Microsoft.

requirements: A Microsoft account and the Dev Mode app from the store.
warnings: Developer Mode is not a jailbreak. It has documented limits and needs a Microsoft account.

homebrew.name: RetroArch
homebrew.firmware: Requires Developer Mode; runs as a UWP app on any system-software version
homebrew.summary: The libretro frontend packaged as a UWP app, running emulator cores for many classic systems. RetroArch's download page states that Xbox One/Series use requires Developer Mode.
homebrew.availability: Free download from retroarch.com; runs only in Developer Mode.
homebrew.systems: Many classic systems via libretro cores

compatibility.note: Developer Mode is the documented requirement; the download page states it for Xbox One/Series.

requirements: Developer Mode enabled on the console.
The RetroArch UWP package, plus your own game files and BIOS files.
warnings: Developer Mode is required and costs a one-time Microsoft fee; there is no official Retail build.
No games or BIOS files are bundled.

homebrew.name: Security research (privilege escalation, browser issues)
homebrew.summary: Security research catalogued by the Xbox One Research Wiki is applicable in principle to this generation. No public retail exploit or boot-chain modification is documented.

compatibility.note: The 360's Bad Update page explicitly excludes Xbox One/Series. No RGH/JTAG-class exploit page for this generation.

warnings: Not a user route. No custom firmware or boot-chain modification is documented for this generation.

homebrew.name: Xbox Series offline system update (OSU)
homebrew.summary: Microsoft's USB-based update and recovery for a console that will not boot. Reinstalls the system software. Series S has no disc drive — disc-based recovery is not possible on it.

compatibility.note: Official recovery track shared by the whole family.

requirements: USB drive with the official OSU file.
warnings: Leave Developer Mode: switch back to Retail Mode and remove the Dev Mode storage; the console returns to a normal retail state.

officialSupport.summary: Xbox Series X|S remains the current generation; Developer Mode is active for both models.
